text:
maria (partnerships): ACME marketplace flagged that our published runtime images fail their signing policy: kernel module signatures missing / don't match. They want either a pinned driver+CUDA combo with signed kernel blobs or a published compatibility matrix we guarantee. Who can own a short proposal?

alex (eng-runtime): We can provide signed, immutable marketplace images + a generated compat CSV. Prefer offering a small set of certified tags rather than a broad pin. That keeps rollback flexibility.

todd (platform): Marketplace customers usually require deterministic images. We should publish vendor-certified tags (e.g. rwinf/acme-a100:driver-525-cuda12.2-signed) and enforce tag immutability. Need gating, canary window, and signature audit fingerprints in the manifest.

jia (partner-eng): ACME wants: signed kernel modules (they validate via KMS), a CSV manifest for compatibility, and a hotfix plan for regressions during certification. Also requested embargoed joint announcement timeline.

ben (sre): Note: nightly CI caught a perf regression on CUDA 12.3 quant kernels for A100 after runtime patch (job infra/nightly/quant-regression-a100). If we choose driver 525 for ACME it avoids that, but we must ensure CI verifies no regressions across our other customers.

maria (partnerships): Proposed path: 1) Create a "certified" image channel that is immutable & signed. 2) Auto-generate and publish compat CSV on successful CI. 3) Provide HSM/KMS-backed signing and public key metadata. 4) 48h canary before partner pull. 5) Hotfix/rollback playbook. Agree?

alex (eng-runtime): Yes. CI will run a trimmed compat matrix: launch, p99 perf sample, and a short model-infer smoke. We'll add a job to sign artifacts and emit the CSV. Example snippet: 
```
# simplified
./ci/build-image --tag rwinf/acme-a100:525-cuda12.2-signed
./ci/sign-kmod --kmod out/driver-525.ko --kms /env/kms-acme --out signed/driver-525.sig
./ci/publish --image rwinf/acme-a100:525-cuda12.2-signed --manifest compat/acme-525.csv
```

todd (platform): I'll implement tag freeze + publish job. Also ensure manifest includes SHA256 of signed blob and signature fingerprint.

jia (partner-eng): I'll own the partner CSV rows and the public manifest endpoint. Will coordinate embargo & joint announcement copy once we hit green canary.

ben (sre): I'll write the rollback playbook: hotfix branch that retags previous kernel, re-signs, and pushes. Also wire an SLO smoke alert to trigger on canary failures.

maria (partnerships): ACME asked for a certification window next week (Mon-Wed). Can we get a canary image ready?

alex (eng-runtime): I can open the signing-service PR today; minimal MVP in ~48h.

todd (platform): Publish job and tag freeze ETA: EOD tomorrow if prioritized.

jia (partner-eng): I'll prepare the CSV skeleton and manifest endpoint today.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: infra/canary/acme-image-20260316 starting 2026-03-16T02:00Z. Notifying @partners @sre.

maria (partnerships): Action items recap: alex -> signing-service PR; todd -> publish job + tag freeze; jia -> compat CSV + manifest; ben -> rollback playbook + SLO alert. I'll update ACME with provisional schedule and legal/embed note. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
